title: Large Language Models for Biomedical Article Classification

model.params_source: paper Sec. 3.5-3.10 (temperature 0; Token-Word output: class probabilities from the first-token top-20 logprobs available through the OpenAI API; 3-shot examples by L2 similarity in all-distilroberta-v1 space)

task.subset_rule: all abstracts of the 15 DCR datasets (Table 2 counts), stratified 5-fold cross-validation (seed 20260907): each abstract classified once with examples drawn from its training folds
task.approximation: CV fold seed differs from the authors'; some PubMed abstracts may be missing or revised since the 2006 release; the exact topic strings inserted for {topic} are not printed (dataset names of Table 2 used).

items.source: DCR systematic drug-class review data (Cohen et al. 2006): https://dmice.ohsu.edu/cohenaa/systematic-drug-class-review-data.html, file epc-ir-data/epc-ir.clean.tsv (topic, PMID, abstract-level and article-level inclusion); abstracts fetched from PubMed E-utilities by PMID
items.license: DCR data page: unknown (public research release); PubMed abstracts: NLM terms

fields_prose.label: abstract-level inclusion (positive) vs exclusion (Table 2 positive rates match the abstract-level column)

prompt.user_template:
[user] Is this an abstract of a high-quality article on {topic}? Answer yes or no.
"{example_text}"
[assistant] {example_answer}
(the user/assistant pair above is repeated for each of the 3 examples)
[user] Is this an abstract of a high-quality article on {topic}? Answer yes or no.
"{text}"

placeholders.example_text: 3-shot nearest neighbours from the training folds (not expressible)

prompt.few_shot: k=3 nearest training-fold abstracts in all-distilroberta-v1 embedding space (Few-Shot-Selection experiment, Sec. 3.8)
prompt.source_location: Appendix A, Table 14 (prompt B, few-shot), used in the Baseline experiment (Sec. 3.10)

placeholders_prose.topic: review topic of the dataset (Table 2 name, e.g. 'ACE inhibitors')
placeholders_prose.example_text: abstract of a training-fold example (3 nearest by L2 distance of all-distilroberta-v1 embeddings)
placeholders_prose._note: [user]/[assistant] markers denote chat turns; the first user message and the assistant message are repeated per example (Appendix A, Table 14 note)

output.postprocess: tokens outside the top-20 treated as probability zero (Sec. 3.10); neither prefix present -> 0.5
output.parse_prose: logprobs: from the top-20 first-token distribution, sum the probabilities of tokens that are case-insensitive prefixes of 'yes' and of 'no'; P(positive) = p_yes / (p_yes + p_no)

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: AUPRC (area under the precision-recall curve) of P(positive) per DCR dataset over its 5 CV folds, macro-averaged over the 15 datasets ('Average' row).
metric.original_location: Table 11 (Macro-averaged AUPRC scores for the Baseline experiment), column gptna, row Avg

open_points: no hook: 3-shot examples are chosen by all-distilroberta-v1 embedding similarity inside 5 CV folds (needs torch/sentence-transformers), ~16.5k PubMed abstracts must be fetched by PMID (the TSV carries labels only), scoring uses the first-token top-20 logprobs (a hook's parse() receives only the text; logprobs sit in the archived response) and the metric is per-dataset AUPRC macro-averaged over 15 datasets.
epc-ir.clean.tsv has no header row (topic, EndNote id, PMID, abstract-level label, article-level label).
notes: One call per abstract per seed (3 seeds = 49,449 calls) with max_tokens 1. Per-dataset gptna AUPRCs in Table 11 allow a per-topic check. Retrieval of ~16.5k PubMed abstracts and the embedding step are local preprocessing.
